_comment: A stand-in for the feedback context endpoint serving F5, for looking at Build D without n8n. Point VITE_FEEDBACK_CONTEXT_URL at /feedback-context-employee-check-in.sample.json and any token-shaped ?t= on /feedback/employee-check-in opens it. Everything here is invented: there is no employee called Grace Wanjiru. NOTE: until the nine ClickUp question fields exist, this route renders 'not finished being set up' rather than a form — that is the designed behaviour, see src/feedback/employeeCheckIn.ts.
_prefill: fullName is the EMPLOYEE — on this form the reader is also the subject, so there is no subjectName. reviewPoint is 'Day 30' through 'Day 180'; the same nine questions arrive six times and it is the only thing that tells them apart.
